description: This file defines a Spring Boot configuration class for the HTTP adapter within the Eclipse Hono project. It provides bean definitions, configuration properties, and customization methods related to the HTTP adapter, as well as metrics setup.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Spring Boot configuration class for the HTTP adapter, defining beans, properties, and customization methods for the Hono HTTP adapter.

methods.name: vertxBasedHttpProtocolAdapter
methods.description: Creates and provides a new instance of VertxBasedHttpProtocolAdapter as a Spring Bean with prototype scope.

methods.name: customizeDownstreamSenderFactoryConfig
methods.description: Customizes the ClientConfigProperties by setting its name if not already set.

methods.name: customizeRegistrationClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Customizes the RequestResponseClientConfigProperties for registration client configuration.

methods.name: customizeCredentialsClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Customizes the RequestResponseClientConfigProperties for credentials client configuration.

methods.name: adapterProperties
methods.description: Exposes HttpProtocolAdapterProperties as a Spring bean, configured via 'hono.http' prefix.

methods.name: commonTags
methods.description: Provides a MeterRegistryCustomizer for adding common tags to metrics for the protocol adapter.

methods.name: serviceFactory
methods.description: Creates a factory bean for producing instances of VertxBasedHttpProtocolAdapter.
